About Jeffrey

Jeffrey Gillman is a Licensed Mental Health Counselor with over 10 years of experience working with individuals, couples, and families. He specializes in helping clients navigate anxiety, depression, and relationship challenges through a relational and trauma-informed approach.

Jeffrey believes in creating a safe, non-judgmental space where clients can explore their thoughts and feelings. He uses evidence-based practices including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT), and mindfulness techniques to support clients in their healing journey.

In his free time, Jeffrey enjoys hiking in the Pacific Northwest, reading contemporary fiction, and spending time with his family. He is passionate about social justice and works to create an inclusive therapeutic environment for all clients, particularly those from marginalized communities.

Education & Training

  • Master of Arts in Counseling Psychology, Seattle University
  • Bachelor of Science in Psychology, University of Washington
  • Certified in EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing)
